item.title: Armenian central bank raises refinancing rate by 0.25 percentage point to 6.75%
item.description: The Board of the Central Bank of Armenia (CBA) decided today to raise the refinancing rate by 0.25 percentage point to 6.75%, the Lombard repo facility rate to 8.25% and the deposit facility rate to 5.25%.
